title: Let vigilance become trust
subtitle: For the heart that keeps calling fear wisdom
description: These readings do not shame vigilance; they place it under the Merciful Creator until protection is no longer confused with constant bracing.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The Creator who forms, nourishes, and cherishes the mortal is a truer shelter than fear’s watchtower.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Keep the needed care, but release the extra bracing that has become your false refuge.

evidence.coreClaim: This path converts vigilance into trust by returning protection to the One who actually sustains life.
evidence.turn: Trust begins when fear stops being treated as the only responsible voice.
evidence.practicalImplication: Do the prudent thing once; then refuse to rehearse the danger as devotion.
